tasks.title: Phase 2: Create ToolTemplateEngine.ts
tasks.description: Build the core template engine that manages all 13 tool templates with variable substitution using a config-driven approach
tasks.details:
Create: src/services/coaching/ToolTemplateEngine.ts and rag/13ToolsRAG-01-templates.json

Must include:
- ToolTemplate interface definition based on JSON structure
- Config-driven loading from JSON files (not hard-coded templates)
- fillTemplate() method for variable substitution
- extractSimpleVariables() method for instant extraction
- getTool() and getAllTools() helper methods
- LED breadcrumbs 6550-6599

JSON Structure (per tool):
```
{
  "id": 13,
  "name": "Take Away",
  "description": "...",
  "when_use": "...",
  "templates": [
    {
      "pattern": "You're right - if {{OBJECTION}} then we shouldn't move forward. What about {{CONCERN}} concerns you?",
      "variables": ["OBJECTION", "CONCERN"],
      "confidence": "high"
    }
  ],
  "triggers": {
    "keywords": ["expensive", "not sure", "maybe"],
    "regex": "not sure|think about|maybe later",
    "sentimentBias": "negative",
    "stageBias": [7, 8, 9]
  },
  "variableExtraction": {
    "OBJECTION": {
      "method": "keyword" | "ai",
      "prompt": "Extract objection phrase (3-5 words)",
      "maxTokens": 10
    }
  }
}
```

Constructor signature:
```typescript
constructor(configFile: string = '13ToolsRAG-01-templates.json')
```

Verification criteria:
- File exists at correct path
- JSON config file created with all 13 tools defined
- BreadcrumbTrail imported and used (LED 6550, 6552, 6553, 8550)
- fillTemplate() correctly replaces {{VARIABLE}} placeholders
- extractSimpleVariables() handles Tools 1, 5, 13 at minimum
- Config switching works without code changes

4. Unit test fillTemplate(13, {OBJECTION: "cost", CONCERN: "budget"}) contains both words
5. Verify LED 6550 fires on construction

7. TypeScript compiles without errors

9. Test with new: 13ToolsRAG-01-templates.json (full template system)
10. Verify config switching works without code changes

tasks.title: Phase 3: Create PatternMatchingLibrary.ts
tasks.description: Build pattern matching system for instant tool selection without AI (60-70% hit rate)
tasks.details:
Create: src/services/coaching/PatternMatchingLibrary.ts

Must include:
- PatternMatchingLibrary class
- matchTool() method that checks keywords, regex, sentiment bias, stage bias
- Returns {toolId, confidence} or null
- LED breadcrumbs 6600-6649

Pattern matching logic:
- Check tool.triggers.keywords against transcript.toLowerCase()
- Validate sentiment bias matches context.sentiment
- Validate stage bias includes context.stage
- Try regex patterns if keyword match fails
- Return null if no confident match

Verification criteria:
- File exists at correct path
- Constructor accepts ToolTemplateEngine instance
- matchTool() returns correct toolId for "expensive" → Tool 13
- matchTool() returns null for non-matching transcript
- LED 6602 fires on keyword match

tasks.title: Phase 12: Code Quality & Documentation
tasks.description: Verify clean codebase: no dead code, proper LED coverage, code comments, type safety
tasks.details:
Code quality checklist:

1. Dead Code Removal:
   - Search for any old AI generation imports
   - Remove commented-out code
   - Delete unused helper functions
   - Verify no orphaned files

2. LED Breadcrumb Coverage:
   - All new files use BreadcrumbTrail
   - All critical operations have LEDs
   - LED ranges documented (6550-6699)
   - Success and failure paths covered

3. TypeScript Compliance:
   - No 'any' types (use proper interfaces)
   - All public methods have return types
   - All interfaces exported properly
   - Zero TypeScript errors

4. Code Comments:
   - Each class has JSDoc header
   - Complex logic has inline comments
   - LED numbers documented
   - Public methods documented

5. File Organization:
   - All new files in correct directories
   - Imports organized and minimal
   - No circular dependencies

Verification:
- Compile with strict mode
- Run linter
- Review all new files
- Check import statements
- Verify LED documentation
